title: FRANK event envelope
description: FRANK-§6.7. CloudEvents-compatible envelope with explicit schema version, cell scope, correlation, causation, classification, and idempotency. A transaction writes domain state and the outbox event together (ADR-004).

type.description: Versioned event type. The trailing .vN is required so consumers pin a schema (ADR-017).

cellid.description: FRANK-§2.4. Every event is scoped to exactly one cell. Cross-cell delivery is not representable.

idempotencykey.description: Required for events that drive an external side effect (FRANK-§13.5).
